children: , the global payments network, began processing live SoFiUSD settlement for SoFi's debit and credit cards. Shares were up 1.25% to $562.815. The partnership has moved beyond a trial: transactions are running on the blockchain.

SoFi is migrating a card program expected to handle more than $25 billion in annualized volume. That is the size of the card program, not a reported total of stablecoin transactions or new revenue for Mastercard. It is reported that SoFi also plans to offer stablecoin settlement to other financial companies through its Galileo platform.

The bigger question is whether faster settlement brings more business onto Mastercard's network. The picture puts GF Value at $684.46, with the share price 17.77% below that estimate. That gap is striking, but the payoff from SoFiUSD still depends on how widely customers use it.

title: Mastercard Goes Live With SoFiUSD Settlement for $25 Billion Card Program
